parts.label: (a)
parts.stem:
Methyl 2-cyanoprop-2-enoate, **W**, is the major component of *Super Glue*, a rapid-setting adhesive. As the adhesive sets, the monomer **W** polymerises.

{{figure:pdf_visual_01.png}}

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text:
Draw a section of the polymer showing **two** repeat units.

{{figure:pdf_visual_02.png}}

parts.label: (a)(ii)
parts.text: Name the type of polymerisation occurring.

parts.label: (a)(iii)
parts.text:
Suggest **two** types of intermolecular force that could occur between the *Super Glue* polymer and the objects glued together. For each type of intermolecular force, refer to the atoms/groups in the *Super Glue* polymer involved in the attraction.

parts.stem:
**W** can be synthesised in three steps, starting from 2-oxopropanoic acid, **X**.

{{figure:pdf_visual_03.png}}

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: Suggest the identities of compounds **Y** and **Z** by drawing their structures in the boxes.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: Suggest suitable reagents and conditions for each of the steps 1-3.
